issues.description: Method SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice: the problem statement explicitly requires calculateTotalPrice to be a static method (shared across all SealSaloon instances), but in the solution implementation it is declared as an instance method (public int calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal)). This mismatch between the specification (static) and the implementation (non-static) can confuse students about the required method modifier and how the method should access the shared static stock.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method signature match the specification by declaring it static: change to 'public static int calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal)'. Update any call sites or documentation to call the static method (e.g., SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(meal)) or allow instance calls if desired, and ensure the implementation uses the shared static stock field consistently. Alternatively, if the intended design is for an instance method, update the problem statement to remove the 'static' requirement so both artifacts are consistent.
